title: Change booking form email input to use X symbol

requirements.summary: Update the email input field in the Booking component to display 'X' as its associated symbol or icon
acceptanceCriteria: The email input field in the Booking form displays 'X' as its associated symbol or icon
The input field functionality remains unchanged and still accepts email addresses
The form validation continues to work correctly for the email field

file_operations.description: Update the email input field to use 'X' as the input symbol/icon. Locate the email input at the specified XPath position (second input in the first column of form fields) and modify its icon/symbol to display 'X' while preserving all existing functionality, validation, and form submission behavior.
